notes: Maps CMU/ARPAbet phoneme groups to Modern Archivist mouth layers. Silence and bilabial stops (M, B, P) map to mouth_closed. Vowels map to appropriate open states: AA/AO/AW/AY/AH/G/K/NG map to mouth_open_a (wide, jaw open); EH/EY/AE/IH/IY/F/V/Y map to mouth_open_e (spread/smiling); OW/OY/UH/UW/ER/R/W map to mouth_open_o (rounded lips). Fricatives, affricates, and tongue/teeth consonants (S, Z, SH, ZH, CH, JH, T, D, TH, DH, L, N, HH) map to mouth_slight_open for visibility. This strategy balances phonetic accuracy with the limited mouth layer palette.
